description.value: Select is Shell's convenience store brand operating at this 24-hour Shell service station on Kingsway in Burnaby. The station carries fuel, a convenience shop with food and drink options, and offers delivery partnerships with Uber Eats and Skip the Dishes. Its round-the-clock availability and location on a major east-west corridor make it a practical resupply point for cyclists moving through the Burnaby area.
